name: manual_0eec25
claim: A differential over every launch path in a mirrored policy pair must also compare the config files and the pin documents, because a row only one repo carries is invisible to a path list it was never added to.

decisions.notes: PT and orama-system diverged on the gpt-5.6-terra row, the Alexandria pin tip and the generic ungated-row check; the 1,764-case table matched while behavior differed. Fixed by mirroring all three and adding the Terra path to the shared differential (2,058 cases).
